items.title:
1/ 🔴 NAC, glutamate and the brain: why is such an old mucolytic drug attracting interest in depression, multiple sclerosis, autoimmune disease, ME/CFS and Long COVID?

Because N-acetylcysteine does not act on a single pathway. It sits at a particularly interesting intersection between glutamate regulation, glutathione, oxidative stress, mitochondria, astrocytes and immunity.

And when several of those systems are disrupted at the same time, a molecule capable of influencing several of them becomes especially interesting. 🧵
